 Renata Quintini and Roseanne Wincek – Renegade Spin-Out in the Supercritical Stage, Venture is Eating the Investment World 11 (Capital Allocators, EP. 242) Mar 21, 2022

 Renata Quintini and
Roseanne Wincek are the Co-Founders and Managing Partners of
Renegade Partners, a venture capital firm they launched in 2019
after each experienced life inside top-notch venture firms – Renata
at Felicis and Lux and Rosanne at Canaan Partners and IVP. 
They raised a first fund of $100 million to focus on the
“Supercritical Stage” of a company’s development. 
 

Our conversation discusses the dynamics of a venture capital
spinout and the nuances of a stage-focused strategy. First, we dive
into their backgrounds, lessons learned from their experience,
forming a partnership and strategy together, and going to market.
Then, we discuss Renegade’s investment process across sourcing,
filtering, winning deals, and working with companies. We close with
perspectives on the competitive landscape, battle for talent, and
areas of growth internally, including the application of our mutual
friend Annie Duke’s decision 

theories to the practice of venture investing.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
